intro: Around 5.5 million Palestinians live in the West Bank and Gaza, and millions more live in Israel, Jordan, Lebanon, Syria and around the world.

chapters.title: People and faith
text: Most Palestinians are Sunni Muslim, with a Christian community in places like Bethlehem and Ramallah. Arabic is the language. The population is young.
Many families are descended from 1948 refugees, and UN refugee camps have become crowded neighbourhoods.

chapters.title: Learning
text: Palestinians have high literacy rates, and universities like Birzeit are important centres of learning. War has destroyed most of Gaza's schools and universities.

keyTerms.meaning: The UN agency for Palestinian refugees.
